descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S26 A chart changes after its summary was made: a reopened sheet drops the completed task and shows the new one; what an open sheet shows is recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Sender with the S01 census; the sheet has finished generating

When The runner, in another session, marks H1's 'Discharge home once PT clears him' done and adds the open task 'QA-NEW-H1 page ortho'. (b) Without leaving the sheet, wait 15 s and save it, open Send to… and save the dialog, Cancel. …

Then (a) After reopening, H1's handoff no longer lists the completed discharge task, gains no invented barrier in its place and lists the new task; the other patients are unchanged. (b) What the open sheet and the Send dialog show before reopening is recorded for Q14

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on s26-reopened-copy: H1's card contains 'QA-NEW-H1' and none of 'PT clear', 'clears him', 'physical therap'; each patient token exactly once. s26-open-sheet and s26-open-send only need their screen anchors: their content is recorded, not judged, until Q14 is answered. e2e/api/handoff-summaries.spec.ts covers the server's input-hash rule, not what the physician sees

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
